title: Prado journeys into the ancient world with art inspired by Homer's Odyssey
description: As Christopher Nolan brings Homer’s Odyssey to the screen, the Museo Nacional del Prado is inviting audiences to explore how artists have imagined the ancient world across more than two millennia. The Madrid museum has released a new video that brings together 24 paintings, sculptures and drawings inspired by classical mythology, the Trojan War and the perilous journeys at the heart of Greek and Roman storytelling. Set to Dinamita, a song by Spanish musician La Bien Querida, the sequence moves from the Judgment of Paris and the abduction of Helen to the burning of Troy, the travels of Aeneas and the ordeals of Odysseus. Rather than offering a conventional art-historical lecture, the project creates an emotional and cinematic journey through the Prado’s collection.
